caption: One bar in one row: the title and the obelisk-of-light place on the left, the six views and the waiting hand in the centre, New task, Filter, More and the coral Ask Caw on the right.
The same one bar at his window: the six views fold into a Board pill beside the waiting hand.
The phone's bar is the title and More; the views, the waiting hand and the coral Ask Caw sit in the docked foot bar.
Two rows: the title, the place, More and Ask Caw on top; under them a shelf with the six views, the waiting hand, New task and Filter.
The two rows at his window: all six views stay named on the shelf.
On the phone H2 is the same as H1: the title and More on top, the views and Ask Caw in the foot bar.
Five columns share the width with no strip; empty stages are a head over a one-row well.
At his window the columns can't fit, so the board turns into D2: the stage strip over 300px columns that scroll sideways.
The stage strip with every count over 300px columns: Ready, Working and Review whole, Done cut at the edge, Dropped past it.
The same board at his window: the strip keeps every stage and count in view while two columns and part of a third show.
The stage strip wraps to two rows over Ready's cards: every stage and count in the first view.
One grouped list: Ready open under its head, the other four heads pinned above the foot bar.
The Table: rows grouped by stage under sticky heads with counts; Done and Dropped folded and pinned at the foot.
The phone's Table: one group open, the other heads pinned above the foot bar.
tsk-17 waits in Working with the needs-you mark (dot, hand, asks) and its ask on a line of its own; tsk-16 waits in Review. Drawn for the state.
The phone opens on Working, where tsk-17's ask stands with its mark. Drawn for the state.
The same waiting card with Deny and Approve as untinted peers at its foot, for a permission. Drawn for the state.
Deny and Approve at opposite ends of the card on the phone. Drawn for the state.
tsk-16's pane beside the board, opened at its title: the task, its jump strip, then its description first.
The pane as its own page on the phone, opened at its title, Send back and Approve docked at the foot.
tsk-16's pane opened on its Result: the title condensed in the bar, the jump strip sticky, the handed-in result and Send back, Approve in view.
The phone's pane opened on the Result, the verdict docked at the foot.
The hub didn't answer: one band under the bar says who, when it retries and what to do, over the board as it last read. Drawn for the state.
The band stacks to three lines on the phone, the board kept under it. Drawn for the state.
The hub didn't answer: a stale dot on the place, its popover open with who, when and what to do; the board kept. Drawn for the state.
The stale mark beside the phone's title, its popover open under the bar. Drawn for the state.
Caw's column with no title bar: Caw on the axis, his line, three starters stacked as full sentences, the composer.
The half-height sheet on the phone: Caw, his line and the stack don't fit above the composer, so the stack scrolls.
Caw's column with the three starters as one row docked over the composer, scrolling sideways.
The half-height sheet: Caw's line, the row of starters and the composer.
